My work asks how much disease burden routine health information systems fail to record, and what statistical tools can recover it. I mainly use **R**, combining Bayesian modelling, interrupted time-series designs and geospatial analysis. Select a project to read more.

## <i class="bi bi-heart-pulse"></i> Maternal health {#maternal-health}

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.pcard .linked}
[Undergraduate thesis]{.tag}

### Maternal Mortality in Kenya, 2018–2025

An interrupted time-series and counterfactual analysis comparing trends in routine and audited surveillance data.

[Interrupted time series · Counterfactuals]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/maternal-mortality-kenya.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Research fellowship]{.tag}

### Hidden Maternal Deaths in Nairobi's Informal Settlements

A Bayesian hierarchical zero-inflated negative binomial model for deaths missing from the records.

[Bayesian ZINB · Spatial access]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/nairobi-maternal-mortality.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::
:::

## <i class="bi bi-geo-alt"></i> Bayesian & spatial modelling {#modelling}

::: {.card-grid}
::: {.pcard .linked}
[Spatial epidemiology]{.tag}

### Conflict-Driven Acceleration of Malaria Exposure

A spatial interrupted time-series analysis of how armed conflict changed malaria exposure in Cameroon, 2010–2024.

[Spatial ITS · Conflict exposure indexing · GIS]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/malaria-conflict-cameroon.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Workshop · EpiBio Club]{.tag}

### Predicting Cholera in Informal Settlements

A GIS workshop on using environmental exposure indices, WASH data and spatial modelling to map cholera risk.

[GIS · Exposure indices · WASH]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/surveillance-kenya.qmd#cholera-gis-workshop){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::
:::

### Outbreak Response in Kenya, 2026

Visceral Leishmaniasis mortality analysis, case definitions for school outbreaks, a hospital surveillance tool and Mpox contact tracing.

[IDSR · Case definitions · Contact tracing]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/surveillance-kenya.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::

::: {.pcard .linked}
[Community field study · Cameroon]{.tag}

### Diagnostic Baseline for Batoukop

A free one-month clinic that produced the community's first prevalence data for malaria, typhoid serology and anemia.

[Prevalence survey · Referral pathways]{.methods} [Read more →](projects/batoukop-diagnostics.qmd){.read-more .stretched-link}
:::
